::: {tbl-colwidths="[15,20,15,50]"}
| **Symbol**                    | **Definition**                       | **Unit**                                             | **Notes**                                                                                                                                                         |
|:------------------------------|:-------------------------------------|:-----------------------------------------------------|:------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **$H$**                       | **Action Chunk Horizon**             | Time steps                                           | Number of contiguous future action steps generated in a single policy forward pass ($H=16$ on the mobile manipulator; 16 to 64 steps in the literature).          |
| **$f_{\text{exec}}$**         | **Action Execution Rate**            | $\text{Hz}$                                          | Temporal consumption rate of chunked waypoints along the planned trajectory ($100\text{ Hz}$ to $1\text{ kHz}$).                                                  |
| **$D_{\text{cycle}}$**        | **Actuator Duty Cycle**              | $[0, 1]$                                             | Ratio of active pulse duration to cycle period ($t_{\text{on}} / (t_{\text{on}} + t_{\text{off}})$) preventing thermal runaway.                                   |
| **$T_{\text{act}}$**          | **Actuator Response Time**           | $\text{ms}$                                          | Time from a delivered stop command to retarding force, including gate-drive and current rise, which enters $\tau_{\text{delay}}$.                                 |
| **$D_{\text{clear}}$**        | **Clear Distance**                   | $\text{m}$                                           | Clear distance from the machine to the boundary it must not cross; the subscript keeps it distinct from dataset size $D$.                                         |
| **$T_{\text{bus}}$**          | **Command Transport Time**           | $\text{ms}$                                          | Fieldbus delivery time from the permission path to the drive, which enters $\tau_{\text{delay}}$.                                                                 |
| **$a_{\text{brake}}$**        | **Credible Deceleration**            | $\text{m/s}^2$                                       | Validated low tail of the deceleration the machine achieves under its stated conditions, not the datasheet peak.                                                  |
| **$\Delta V_{\text{droop}}$** | **DC Bus Dynamic Rail Droop**        | $\text{V}$                                           | Transient voltage collapse ($\Delta I R_{\text{bus}} + L_{\text{bus}}\frac{dI}{dt} + \frac{\Delta I \Delta t}{2 C_{\text{bus}}}$) under step motor current loads. |
| **$v_h$**                     | **Human Walking-Speed Bound**        | $\text{m/s}$                                         | Walking-speed bound for a person approaching the machine, used in the form its safety standard states.                                                            |
| **$t_{\text{xfer}}$**         | **Interconnect Transfer Time**       | $\text{ms}$                                          | DMA bus streaming, PCIe handoff, and serializer-deserializer (SerDes) link latency; contributes to $t_{\text{age}}$.                                              |
| **$j_{\max}$**                | **Jerk Limit**                       | $\text{m/s}^3$                                       | Maximum rate of change of deceleration; appears only in jerk-limited refinements of the braking term, which the book's stopping equations omit.                   |
| **$\delta_{\text{loc}}$**     | **Localization Bound**               | $\text{m}$                                           | Bound on localization and state-estimation error.                                                                                                                 |
| **$g$**                       | **Message Injection Gap**            | $\text{failures/hour}$                               | Statutory regulatory safety requirement (e.g., $10^{-9}\text{ failures/h}$ for SIL 4 / DAL A).                                                                    |
| **$m$**                       | **Microbatch Count**                 | $\text{failures/hour}$                               | Certified dangerous failure rate of the integrated cyber-physical machine.                                                                                        |
| **$\text{PM}_{\text{net}}$**  | **Net Phase Margin**                 | $\text{deg}$                                         | Residual stability margin ($\text{PM}_{\text{plant}} - \Delta \Phi_{\text{total}} > 0$) preventing contact chatter.                                               |
| **$\omega_c$**                | **Open-Loop Crossover Frequency**    | $\text{rad/s}$                                       | Frequency at which open-loop gain $\lvert L(j\omega_c) \rvert = 1$ ($0\text{ dB}$).                                                                               |
| **$t_{\text{stream}}$**       | **Parameter Streaming Time**         | $\text{ms}$                                          | Time required to stream non-resident model weights into execution registers.                                                                                      |
| **$T_{\text{tick}}$**         | **Permission-Loop Period**           | $\text{ms}$                                          | Period of the permission loop, which enters $\tau_{\text{delay}}$ because a hazard may wait up to one period before it is checked.                                |
| **$\Delta \phi$**             | **Phase Lag Degradation**            | $\text{rad}$ / $\text{deg}$                          | Phase erosion ($\Delta \Phi \approx 28.65^\circ \cdot (\omega_c / f_s)$) depleting closed-loop stability margin.                                                  |
| **$t_{\text{infer}}$**        | **Proposer Inference Time**          | $\text{ms}$                                          | Forward-pass time of the learned proposer; spent above the proposal boundary and outside the permission loop's period.                                            |
| **$\delta_{\text{margin}}$**  | **Protective Clearance**             | $\text{m}$                                           | Fixed, nonzero protective clearance between the machine envelope and the boundary.                                                                                |
| **$f_s$**                     | **Sampling Period and Rate**         | $\text{s}, \text{Hz}$                                | Discrete controller execution period and frequency ($f_s = 1/T_s$).                                                                                               |
| **$t_{\text{sense}}$**        | **Sensor Integration Time**          | $\text{ms}$                                          | Half the exposure duration (its integration midpoint), ADC conversion, and sensor readout latency; contributes to $t_{\text{age}}$.                               |
| **$v$**                       | **Speed at Detection**               | $\text{m/s}$                                         | Speed of the machine at the moment the hazard is detected.                                                                                                        |
| **$\alpha_{\text{sig}}$**     | **Statistical Significance Level**   | Dimensionless                                        | Type I error threshold ($\alpha_{\text{sig}} = 1 - \text{CL}$, e.g., $\alpha=0.05$ for 95% confidence where $-\ln(0.05) \approx 3.0$).                            |
| **$d_{\text{stop}}$**         | **Stopping Distance**                | $\text{m}$                                           | Distance required to bring the plant to rest from speed $v$.                                                                                                      |
| **$\text{BW}_{\text{mem}}$**  | **Sustained Memory Bandwidth**       | bytes/s                                              | Achievable memory throughput of the SoC or accelerator memory subsystem (e.g., LPDDR5, HBM).                                                                      |
| **$R(T_{\text{wind}})$**      | **Temperature-Dependent Resistance** | $\Omega$                                             | Stator copper resistance scaling: $R(T) = R_0 [1 + \alpha_{\text{Cu}}(T - T_0)]$ with $\alpha_{\text{Cu}} = 0.00393\text{ K}^{-1}$.                               |
| **$\tau_{\text{th}}$**        | **Thermal Time Constant**            | $\text{s}$                                           | Actuator heating characteristic time constant ($\tau_{\text{th}} = R_{\text{th}} C_{\text{th}}$, typically $60\text{--}300\text{ s}$).                            |
| **$K_e$**                     | **Torque and Back-EMF Constants**    | $\text{N}\cdot\text{m/A}, \text{V}\cdot\text{s/rad}$ | Motor electromechanical coupling constants ($K_t \approx K_e$ in SI units).                                                                                       |
| **$\epsilon_{\text{track}}$** | **Tracking-Error Bound**             | $\text{m}$                                           | Bound on the deviation between the commanded and the executed trajectory, stated by the enforcement record.                                                       |
| **$M_{\text{weights}}$**      | **Weight Memory**                    | bytes                                                | Total memory required to store policy weights ($P \times \text{bytes-per-parameter}$).                                                                            |
| **$\tau_{\text{ZOH}}$**       | **ZOH Transport Delay**              | $\text{s}$                                           | Equivalent continuous delay introduced by discrete Zero-Order Hold reconstruction ($T_s / 2$).                                                                    |
:::
